author: AlvaroMorata
body:
What's up, I am a free agent, looking for a good team that can compete, I am also looking for a team that has scrims regular meaning that we get some experience. I like to be a holding midfielder, but some people won't say that, some people in nebula might say I am a rusher, that's because I like to rush when it's the right time, but I play as a holding midfielder..  (EU clans would be much appreciated) 

Pros:
I would say I am good with the sword.
Vision - meaning I see who is around the map, and not concentrate on one player.
Smart player - I am not the player who just rushes in and hope for the best, I am very Tactical.
Leader on the field - I would be able to handle tough situations..
Communication -  I am also very good with talking with people. :L I know..
Chemistry: I can always find that player who I play well next to..

Cons:
Cocky at times.
Timzone.
Bow.
